import itertools
y=dv_dt
def tf(name,w):
    return {'1':np.ones_like(t),'t':t,'t2':t**2,'C':np.cos(w*t),'S':np.sin(w*t)}[name]
def model_cost(p, n1, n2, s1, s2, ret=False):
    c,pp,qq,w=p
    if c<=0.01: return 1e3
    E=c*np.exp(-c*np.sqrt(v))
    X=np.abs(x)**pp; V=np.abs(v)**qq
    f1=tf(n1,w)*(X if s1=='x' else V)
    f2=tf(n2,w)*(X if s2=='x' else V)
    M=np.column_stack([E,f1,f2])
    b=np.linalg.lstsq(M,y,rcond=None)[0]
    r=y-M@b
    nm=np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y)
    return (nm,b) if ret else nm
